The four views of the 4+1 model are: 

1. Architectural view (One System, Four Pictures) - showing the system as a single box with everything it touches around it.
2. Logical view (Component diagram) - showing the components and their responsibilities.
3. Physical view (Deployment diagram) - showing the nodes, communication paths, and protocols.
4. Development view (Repository layout) - showing the organization of the source code.

The +1 represents the context or conceptual view, which is not one of the four traditional views, but rather a warning to learn what each view shows, rather than just memorizing a number.
